user_scope: Broad cross-industry discovery; storage eight are a subgroup, not the universe. Cover2026 through latest completed session.
universe_method: All available active and inactive Alpaca us_equity directory entries onNASDAQ/NYSE/AMEX; exclude unsupported symbols and explicit fund/derivative name matches. First duplicate retains active because active read first. Publish exclusions; this is a heuristic, not a certified common-stock or point-in-time master.

screen.ranking: prior20 median(close*volume) descending; symbol ascending for ties; no current/future return sorting
screen.funding: 500 continuous, integer shares, no leverage or extra contributions

signal_rules.breakout20: Completed daily close > highest high of previous20 sessions AND today volume >=1.5*median prior20 volume; candidate ranked prior liquidity; buy next session open and exit at that session close.
signal_rules.reversal: Completed daily return <=-5%, today volume >=1.5*median prior20 volume AND close above today midpoint(high+low)/2; rank prior liquidity; buy next session open and exit that session close.

latency: Signal after prior close, entry next open; data acquisition latency and market-on-close execution not independently verified. No same-close decision execution.
portfolio: At most first highest-prior-liquidity signal per day in top100. If next open costs more than cash for one share, keep cash; no retrospective runner-up. No stop/target intrabar inference. Never use future availability to re-rank. Missing selected next-session input marks path incomplete and stops capital ledger.
corporate_action_policy: Exclude signal days with absolute close-to-previous-close change >20%, retaining reason; heuristic cannot identify all splits/dividends and also loses real events.
outputs: Daily top100 candidates with signals and known-then rank inputs; losing signals retained
Four model paths:two rules bytwo costs; monthly continuous ledgers
Current Oct5-derived candidates for next-session research only, not orders or opportunity promises
limitations: Current active/inactive directory cannot reconstruct all historical listing membership, status dates, symbol reuse or delisted tickers.
Name heuristics do not prove instrument classification or industry coverage; no official sector classification available.
Daily history source may omit delisted data; never call this complete point-in-time US market.
Fixed top100 and thresholds are research hypotheses. Data studied throughOct5 are exploratory, not untouched validation.
Cheap share prices or a quote do not establish affordable option contracts; no option returns modeled.
next_step: Audit broad results and then select multiple event/strategy families for preregistered forward validation; no strategy auto-activation.
